sections.Profile:
"Gunner" is a single-player electro-mechanical pinball machine released by Playmatic in 1974. The game features two flippers, two pop bumpers, two slingshots, two drop targets, and three kick-out holes.

- Manufacturer: Playmatic
- Years made: 1974
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Aviation, Single Player, War, Original Theme, 1970s, Guns
